Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


ABOUT THE EXPLORATION COMPANY

At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.




ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


1. CONTROL & MONITORING ALGORITHM DEVELOPMENT

• Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices.

• Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers.

• Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software).




2. SIMULATION & CONTROLLER DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT

• Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure.

• Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed.

• Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties.

• Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control.




3. HEALTH MONITORING & FAULT MANAGEMENT

• Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…).

• Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis.

• Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability.




4. VALIDATION, TESTING & DOCUMENTATION

• Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware.

• Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis.

• Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files.




WHAT WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE FROM YOU:

• Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus.

• Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control).

• Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++.

• Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery.

• Fluent in English.




NICE TO HAVE: 

• Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems.

• Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models.

• Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis.

• Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection.

• Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…).

• German and/or French.




SKILLS & BEHAVIOURS:

• Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data.

• Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams.

• Organised, able to prioritise tasks and deliver within time constraints.

• Positive, flexible attitude and enthusiasm for space exploration.

• Behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

 - We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

1KOMMA5°: Bei  1KOMMA5°  verfolgen wir eine Vision:  Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?  
 Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist.  
 Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.  Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.
Deine Position: Full-Stack-Entwicklung (Edge to Cloud):  Du entwickelst die Kernkomponenten für unser Energiemanagementsystem  Heartbeat AI Enterprise  – sowohl lokal auf unseren IoT-Gateways (Edge) als auch skalierbar in unserer cloudnativen Backend-Architektur 
 Gateway-Programmierung (Go & Lua):  Du schreibst hochperformanten Code für unsere Edge-Controller. Mit  Golang  baust du robuste Systemdienste und Kommunikationsschichten; mit  Lua  erstellst du leichtgewichtige, dynamisch anpassbare Steuerungsskripte und Protokoll-Treiber für Wechselrichter, BESS und HVAC-Systeme. 
 Cloud Services & Microservices:  Du konzipierst und programmierst in Go skalierbare Microservices im Cloud-Backend zur Verarbeitung von Zeitreihendaten, Telemetrie und für das Flottenmanagement von hunderten Kundenstandorten 
 Schnittstellen & Protokolle:  Du implementierst Kommunikationsprotokolle für das IoT-Umfeld (MQTT, REST/gRPC) sowie für die lokale Anlagenkommunikation (Modbus TCP/RTU) 
 VPP & Trading Integration:  Du ermöglichst den nahtlosen Datenfluss zwischen lokalen Anlagen (Zählerwerte, Flexibilitäten) und unserem Virtuellen Kraftwerk zur automatisierten Steuerung nach Spotmarktpreisen 
 Agile Zusammenarbeit:  Du arbeitest in einem cross-funktionalen Team eng mit Systemarchitekten, SPS-Entwicklern und dem Produktmanagement zusammen, um neue Features für das gewerbliche Energiemanagement zügig auf die Plattform zu bringen
Dein Profil: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Software Engineering oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. fundierte Berufserfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung 
 Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in  Golang (Go)  (idealerweise im Cloud- und Microservice-Kontext) sowie praktische Erfahrung in der Skriptsprache  Lua  (z. B. für embedded / Edge-Anwendungen) 
 Fundiertes Verständnis von Cloud-Technologien (AWS, GCP oder Azure), Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD-Pipelines 
 Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von IoT-Lösungen oder Edge-Computing-Applikationen, bevorzugt auf Linux-basierten Systemen (z. B. Raspberry Pi, Industrie-PCs) 
 Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Netzwerk- und IoT-Protokollen (wie MQTT, REST) sowie idealerweise Berührungspunkte mit industrieller Kommunikation (Modbus) 
 Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und die Motivation, aktiv am Aufbau des größten dezentralen Virtuellen Kraftwerks Europas mitzuwirken 
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Benefits: Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren  brandneuen Büros in der  Hamburger Innenstadt,  Berlin &   München zu arbeiten und/oder  remote 
 Nutze dein  technisches Equipment  auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner  Freizeit  
 Du bist Teil eines  schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel  Entwicklungspotenzi al , wo du  eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
 Bewege dich in  flachen Hierarchien , übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung  Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
 Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend  “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen  konkreten Beitrag zum  nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
 Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem  EGYM-Wellpass 
 Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem  Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs 
 Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

Analog Electronics Design Engineer (m/f/d)  
 About the role  
 We are looking for an Analog Electronics Design Engineer (m/f/d) to join our R&D team in Darmstadt, Germany. 
 You will develop high-performance analog and mixed-signal electronics for HBK's precision measurement and data acquisition systems. Working in a global development environment, you will contribute to the complete product lifecycle, from concept and design to validation and production release. 
 Your Responsibilities  
 Design and development of analog and mixed-signal circuits for precision measurement systems (in Altium Designer or similar) 
 Development of sensor interfaces, signal conditioning circuits and power supplies (in Altium Designer or similar) 
 Creation and review of schematics, PCB layouts and technical documentation 
 Circuit simulation, design verification and performance optimization 
 Hardware bring-up, debugging and laboratory testing 
 Support EMC, environmental and product qualification testing 
 Collaboration with embedded firmware, FPGA, mechanics and test engineering teams 
 Professional Qualifications  
 Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or similar 
 Professional experience in analog electronics development 
 Strong knowledge of:  
 Analog and mixed-signal circuit design 
 Low-noise amplifier and signal conditioning circuits 
 ADCs, DACs and sensor interfaces 
 EMC-aware hardware design 
 SPICE-based simulation tools 
 Experience with PCB development tools such as Altium Designer 
 Practical experience with laboratory equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, signal generators, etc.) 
 Experience with precision measurement systems is highly desirable 
 What Makes You Successful  
 Passion for precision analog electronics and measurement technology 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Hands-on engineering approach and attention to detail 
 Ability to work independently and within international teams 
 Fluent English communication skills 
 We Offer  
 Join a global technology leader in precision measurement and test solutions. Work with experienced engineers on innovative products used worldwide while enjoying an international, collaborative environment with excellent opportunities for professional development. 
 One company – HBK 
 On 1 January 2019, Brüel & Kjær and HBM merged their activities into a new company called HBK (Hottinger Brüel & Kjær). With more than 3,500 employees worldwide and production facilities in Denmark, Germany, the UK, the USA, China and Portugal and presence in 80 countries, HBK is a leading player in the test and measurement area. For further info please visit www.hbkworld.com.

Tätigkeitsbeschreibung: 
 In order to support our Gust Engineer Team, Airbus is looking for a 
 Gust Loads Engineer (d/f/m) 
 Are you passionate about aircraft physics? 
Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to manoeuvres, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?
Do you like to work in an empowered manner? 
Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces? 
This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India.
 We are a team of multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modelling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and  deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning. 
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your main responsibilities 
 Optimize the global design of Airbus products during the concept phases 
 Contributing in building Aerodynamic/Mass/Finite Element  model based using Airbus in-house tools 
 Compute gust loads based on CS25 requirements 
 Develop key competences in the areas of loads and aeroelastics along with the required methods and tools 
 Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journey
 About you 
 You have a Master degree or PhD  in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent 
 You have a strong experience on Aeroelasticity and Finite Element Models (MSC.NASTRAN, ALTAIR HyperWorks)  
 You bring basic knowledge in overall aircraft design and basic competencies in flight loads calculation and flight mechanics 
 You show good knowledge in structural dynamic and are experienced in coding using Python and/or Matlab 
 You are passionate to understand physical aspects and to use your engineering judgement 
 You are a highly motivated, proactive and open-minded person with a great sense of initiative 
 You are keen to deepen your technical knowledge while enjoying to work in a multicultural team   
 Your English is at negotiating level whereas German language skills would be beneficial

 Satellitengestützte Laserkommunikation revolutioniert die Art und Weise, wie Daten im Weltraum übertragen werden. Die rasante technologische Entwicklung dieser Kommunikationstechnik in den letzten zwei Jahrzehnten ermöglicht höhere Datenübertragungsgeschwindigkeiten, größere Sicherheit und eine effizientere Nutzung im Vergleich zur traditionellen Radiofrequenz-Funkübertragung. In unserer Pionierrolle im kommerziellen Einsatz dieser Technologie, bauen wir unseren Vorsprung weiter aus und setzen auf den gezielten Einsatz von modernen Modulations- und Codierverfahren. Bereits heute sind wir mit unseren Systemen im All operativ erfolgreich.

 Auslegung vom LCT Kommunikationssytem
 Untersuchung und Entwicklung von Konzepten für verschiedene Missionsanforderungen, welche die Bandbreite von gängigen Modulationsverfahren (z.B. OOK, QPSK, …) und entsprechende Codier-/Decodierverfahren umfasst für Missionen mit niedrigen Datenraten und großen Entfernungen, sowie hochdatenratige Netzwerke (> 100Gbps)
 Führen von System-Pflichten-/Lastenheft im Bereich des Kommunikationssystems
 Betreuung des Kommunikationssystems bei den verschiedenen LCT Programmen der Produktlinien
 Interne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Systemverantwortlichen des Gesamtsystems und den Geräteverantwortlichen, sowie Gateware und Application Software
 Unterstützung bei Testdurchführung
 Teilnahme an Verhandlungen mit Kunden, sowie Vertretung der Entwicklungs- und Testergebnisse gegenüber den Kunden

 Promotion, Hochschulabschluss (Master, oder vergleichbar) in Informations-/Kommunikationstechnik (Information and Communication Engineering), Elektrotechnik oder verwandter Disziplinen
 Mehrjährige Erfahrungen im Bereich Nachrichtentechnik / Informationstechnik oder digitaler Signalverarbeitung wünschenswert
 Technische Kenntnisse über aktuelle Lasercom-Produkte sowie interdisziplinäre Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Elektrotechnik, Optik und Mechanik
 Belastbarkeit, Flexibilität, Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Organisationstalent sowie analytisches Denken
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
